research_question: When ordinary lexical YV/KV lookup is insufficient, can users express their work or competence in ordinary language well enough for the existing simple deterministic fallback candidate to surface a canonical result they recognize and a blind taxonomy adjudicator accepts?
non_claims: users usually do not know taxonomy vocabulary
KV evidence transfers to occupation discovery

occupation.entrypoint: Beskriv vad du gör i jobbet
occupation.candidate: current frozen simple C2 occupation-description boundary; ordinary lexical YV remains primary
occupation.adjudication_identity: current selectable occupation-name identities; do not force job-title context or nearest concept
occupation.demand_envelope: record whether each independently adjudicated acceptable target is inside the frozen occupation P80 envelope; report in-envelope retrieval separately from out-of-envelope coverage

skill.entrypoint: Beskriv vad du kan eller gör
skill.demand_envelope: 316 frozen P80 skills; do not coerce an independently adjudicated out-of-envelope skill to the nearest P80 target
skill.must_not_promote: query-only numeric sanitation or any higher-complexity candidate

evidence_order: participant description captured without retrieval output and without example text naming or strongly cueing a target
description plus minimal task context frozen
at least one taxonomy-domain adjudicator maps the description to zero, one or multiple acceptable canonical identities while blind to retrieval output; uncertain/unmappable is a valid outcome
ordinary lexical baseline and frozen simple fallback candidate are run
participant may then inspect candidate labels and record recognize/select/none
only after outcome freeze may residuals be classified

elicitation.occupation_prompt: Beskriv vad du gör eller gjorde på jobbet utan att skriva yrkestiteln. Beskriv arbetsuppgifter, verktyg eller system, arbetsmiljö och ansvar som känns viktiga.
elicitation.skill_prompt: Beskriv en konkret kompetens du använder i arbete utan att skriva namnet på kompetensen. Berätta vad du gör, med vilka verktyg eller metoder och vilket resultat du försöker uppnå.
elicitation.reason_no_examples: example text can anchor vocabulary and contaminate the measurement of whether users can naturally express the need
elicitation.minimum_information_rule: do not coach a participant toward a taxonomy term after submission; if the description is insufficient, mark clarification-needed instead of silently enriching it

need: fraction of observed lexical-failure/retry cases for which the user voluntarily chooses or says they would use description fallback
fraction of submitted descriptions adjudicated as sufficiently informative without clarification
fraction whose acceptable target is inside the frozen demand envelope
capability: adjudicated acceptable-target Hit@5 on sufficiently-informative in-envelope cases
paired Hit@5 delta versus ordinary lexical baseline on the same descriptions
participant recognition@5 and successful selection/none rate
residual_classification: retrieval/ranking miss despite adequate in-envelope evidence

reporting_rules: occupation and skill results are never pooled into one accuracy number
report numerator/N and Wilson interval for proportions; do not inflate N with occurrence weights
report unique participants and unique adjudicated target identities alongside query count
ambiguous cases with multiple defensible canonical targets use an acceptable target set rather than forcing one label
unmappable and out-of-envelope cases remain visible in the denominator of need/coverage reporting even when excluded from in-envelope retrieval accuracy
synthetic/model-authored cases may be used only for regression tests, never to satisfy the human evidence gate

complexity_escalation_gate.default: do not test embeddings/neural reranking merely because one human case misses
required_before_higher_model_class: independent human descriptions are frozen before retrieval
the acceptable target is adjudicated and inside the current envelope
the description contains adequate discriminating evidence
plain simple candidate materially misses across multiple independent cases and target identities
residual review shows the dominant cause is retrieval semantics rather than taxonomy ambiguity, missing source evidence, UI wording or coverage
a higher-complexity candidate is then frozen before a new independent holdout

product_separation.primary_lexical_path: must remain available and privileged for users who know a title/skill term
product_separation.fallback: secondary explicit route; no claim that semantic interpretation should replace ordinary YV/KV
product_separation.occupation_plus_location_omnibox: separate product hypothesis; commuting-municipality parsing/search must not be conflated with semantic occupation classification
product_separation.example_modal_test: separate UX experiment after the no-example expressibility benchmark; examples must be diverse and must not be used to create retrieval ground truth

privacy.instruction: participants should not include names, personal identifiers, employer identifiers or unnecessary sensitive personal information
privacy.production_telemetry: do not store raw free text by default merely to compute funnel metrics; raw research text requires an explicit approved study/data-handling basis
privacy.reporting: publish only aggregated metrics and carefully redacted examples

stop_rules: if people cannot naturally provide sufficiently informative descriptions, improve or reconsider the interaction before retrieval complexity
if most failures are out-of-envelope/source/taxonomy problems, do not solve them with a larger retrieval model
if simple fallback does not materially improve over lexical baseline on independent human cases, do not ship it merely because synthetic benchmarks are strong
if simple fallback is already sufficient on independent human evidence, stop model work and focus on discoverability, calibration and safe integration
